summary.vi: Diễn tả một sự việc tương lai được nhìn từ một thời điểm trong quá khứ, dùng would, was/were going to hoặc was/were about to.
summary.en: Talk about a future event as seen from a point in the past, using would, was/were going to, or was/were about to.

when_to_use.vi: Khi thuật lại lời nói hoặc suy nghĩ trong quá khứ về một việc sẽ xảy ra sau đó.
when_to_use.en: When reporting past speech or thoughts about something that was going to happen later.

when_to_use.vi: Khi kể một dự định trong quá khứ mà việc đó chưa hoặc không xảy ra.
when_to_use.en: When describing a past intention that had not happened yet or did not happen.

when_to_use.vi: Khi một hành động đã sắp xảy ra thì bị ngắt bởi một hành động khác.
when_to_use.en: When an action was just about to happen and was interrupted by another action.

when_to_use.vi: Khi kể lại một lịch hẹn hoặc kế hoạch đã được sắp xếp trong quá khứ.
when_to_use.en: When recounting an arrangement or plan that had already been made in the past.

examples.text: I knew the journey would be difficult.

annotation.vi: would + động từ nguyên thể diễn tả một dự đoán trong quá khứ về tương lai.
annotation.en: would + base verb expresses a past prediction about the future.

translation.vi: Tôi biết chuyến đi rồi sẽ khó.
translation.en: I knew the journey would be difficult.

examples.text: We were going to leave at six, but the car broke down.

annotation.vi: was/were going to + động từ nguyên thể diễn tả một dự định trong quá khứ.
annotation.en: was/were going to + base verb expresses a past intention.

translation.vi: Chúng tôi định đi lúc sáu giờ nhưng xe hỏng.
translation.en: We were going to leave at six, but the car broke down.

examples.text: She was about to speak when the phone rang.

annotation.vi: was/were about to + động từ nguyên thể diễn tả một hành động sắp xảy ra trong quá khứ.
annotation.en: was/were about to + base verb expresses an action that was just about to happen in the past.

translation.vi: Cô ấy sắp nói thì điện thoại reo.
translation.en: She was about to speak when the phone rang.

common_mistakes.wrong: He said he will call later.
common_mistakes.right: He said he would call later.

reason.vi: Khi thuật lại lời nói trong quá khứ, will thường chuyển thành would.
reason.en: When reporting speech in the past, will usually shifts to would.

quick_practice.q: I knew she ___ call me later.

explain.vi: Sau 'knew' (quá khứ), dùng 'would' để diễn tả tương lai trong quá khứ.
explain.en: After 'knew' (past), use 'would' to express future in the past.

quick_practice.q: We ___ leave at six, but the car broke down.

explain.vi: Dùng 'were going to' để diễn tả một dự định trong quá khứ.
explain.en: Use 'were going to' to express a past intention.

quick_practice.q: She was about ___ when the phone rang.

explain.vi: Cấu trúc 'be about to + động từ nguyên thể' diễn tả hành động sắp xảy ra.
explain.en: The structure 'be about to + base verb' expresses an action that was just about to happen.

prompt.vi: Viết một câu kể lại một dự định hoặc dự đoán trong quá khứ của bạn, dùng 'would', 'was/were going to' hoặc 'was/were about to'.
prompt.en: Write a sentence about a past plan or prediction you had, using 'would', 'was/were going to', or 'was/were about to'.

sample.text: I knew I would pass the exam.

corrections.issue: R5's example 'He said he was meeting the client the next day.' uses past continuous for future-in-the-past, but the formula and rules do not cover this form, and the example is not included in the structured output.
corrections.fix: Omitted this example to keep the formula consistent with the taught forms (would, was/were going to, was/were about to).

corrections.issue: R5's mistake 'I was about leaving when she arrived.' is corrected to 'I was about to leave when she arrived.', but the error tag 'word_form' is not in the allowed list for common_mistakes (only 'tense' is allowed).
corrections.fix: Used the allowed error tag 'tense' for the common mistake, as the error involves the tense/aspect form of the verb.
